```{r}
library(tidyverse)

mental_health <- read_csv("D:/xz/mental-health-inpatient-activity-deprivation.csv")

mental_health_clean <- mental_health %>%
  select(
    SIMD,
    PatientsRates,
    FinancialYear,
    Dataset,
    HBR
  )

plot_data_all <- mental_health_clean %>%
  filter(
    Dataset == "SMR04",
    HBR == "S92000003",
    SIMD %in% 1:5,
    !is.na(PatientsRates)
  )

plot_data_trend <- plot_data_all %>%
  group_by(FinancialYear, SIMD) %>%
  summarise(
    PatientsRates = mean(PatientsRates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(plot_data_trend,
       aes(x = FinancialYear,
           y = PatientsRates,
           color = factor(SIMD),
           group = SIMD)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = c(
      "1997/98",
      "2002/03",
      "2007/08",
      "2012/13",
      "2017/18",
      "2022/23"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mental Health Inpatient Rates by Deprivation",
    subtitle = "Scotland: Trends Over Time",
    x = "Financial Year",
    y = "Patients per 100,000 Population",
    color = "SIMD Quintile"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
